requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class must be A1, A2, A3, A4, B, or C. Area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), location (Turin), and funding program (CDP/PNRR) are not energy requirements and were not included.
The project is a university student residence, so schools and universities must be nearby. The threshold is the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class C-or-better preference and the future residential use do not map to any reference column and are not applied.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates (haversine on latitude/longitude), energy_class in A1-A4, B or C, and education score >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates, nearest first. No LIMIT applied.
